time_convention: t = frame/24; frame 0 at t=0; time t -> frame round(24 t)
view: top-down (camera looks straight down at a featureless light-grey ground with radial vignette); all three animals walk on the ground plane facing +x (image right). Image y is the lateral direction on the ground.

camera.evidence: no background texture to track; vignette and soft shadows are stable; animal lanes (y) constant; treat as static.

static_objects.ground: uniform light-grey plane, no markings, no other props

reference_point_columns: cx_bbox/cy_bbox (bbox centre, default origin proxy), cx_mask/cy_mask (mask centroid), cx_core/cy_core (centroid of torso after removing legs/head/tail)

brown_horse.description: large dark reddish-brown horse seen from directly above, upper lane (y~345); white muzzle at the right (head) end, dark mane stripe along neck, dark tail at left end. Walks to the right (+x).
brown_horse.note: Its animation/root resets at frame 49: frames 0..48 it walks from cx_bbox 626 to 832 px, then at frame 49 it is back at the frame-0 pose and position (cx 626). Frames 47-48 are nearly identical (cx 832). Treat frame 48->49 as a loop reset, not real motion.

tan_horse.description: large tan/beige horse-like quadruped (horse/donkey) seen from above, middle lane (y~485-500); slightly larger in pixels than the brown horse; white muzzle at right, dark tail and hooves at left. Walks right (+x).

small_brown_animal.description: small orange-brown quadruped (rodent/puppy-like, ~60x33 px) in the lowest lane (y~608), below and ahead of the tan horse. Walks right (+x).

events.what: all three animals already walking right; no start/stop of motion within the clip
brown_horse jumps back ~206 px to its frame-0 position/pose (animation loop reset)
no contacts or collisions: lanes separated (brown y~345, tan y~490, small y~608); small animal stays ahead (right) of the tan horse head throughout.
